the pressure-induced phase transition of graphene to diamene occurs only in 1-layer thick epitaxially grown graphene on SiC and that the phase transition is not observed in thicker epitaxial or exfoliated graphene.
the formation of the ultra-stiff phase, named diamane, occurs exclusively in 1-layer graphene on SiC and that the formation of diamane is not found in thicker epitaxial or exfoliated graphene.
